description:
Our team is made up of students from Colegio Tilatá who are passionate about exploring new technologies and applying them to create more engaging, innovative, and interactive learning experiences.

La Calera, Colombia.
summary:
We have developed an interactive experience designed for young people aged 12 to 15, inviting them to explore the fascinating achievements of space exploration through the missions of the robotic rovers Spirit and Opportunity, as well as the historic flights of the Ingenuity helicopter on Mars.

Through a dynamic, educational, and engaging journey, we aim to introduce young people to the most significant scientific discoveries, technological challenges, and operating mechanisms of these extraordinary machines.

Our goal is to spark scientific curiosity, encourage critical thinking, and inspire future generations by demonstrating how science, engineering, and innovation have enabled humanity to overcome challenges and explore new frontiers in the universe.
details:
Learning for everybody is an interactive educational experience designed for students aged 12 to 15. Through an engaging journey, participants explore the remarkable missions of NASA's Spirit and Opportunity rovers and the historic flights of the Ingenuity helicopter on Mars.

This project makes space exploration more accessible, exciting, and meaningful by combining scientific knowledge, technology, and interactive learning.

Our goal is to inspire the next generation of explorers. By discovering how these extraordinary machines have expanded our knowledge of Mars, students can recognize the power of human creativity, perseverance, and collaboration.
